name: Ananya Rao
text: The Sunset Sky tastes like a Goa sunset in a glass. Ordered it after a beach walk — perfect.

name: Rohit Verma
text: Proper decoction, not watery. Reminds me of home. The wave points kept me coming back.

name: Farah Khan
text: Spicy, buttery, generous. My daughter loved the mild version. Staff is so kind.

name: Srinivas P.
text: ₹49 for chai and samosa is unbeatable near office. Hot, fast, honest taste.

name: Meera Nair
text: Light, refreshing, not overly sweet. Exactly what I needed after the humidity.
